input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position in full: 24.1 lets us assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (notice only); 24.2 bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a Customer competitor; 24.3 applies a mutual reasonable-consent standard to other assignments; and 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any termination, suspension, repricing, acceleration or service-reduction right on our change of control. Section 13.3 aligns licence transfer with permitted Section 24 assignments, so no carve-out is undercut. No redline needed.
